caption: The drawing shows a bowl-shaped silver basket with a single arched beaded handle, composed of rounded beads that are evenly spaced along the edge of the rim and on the handle itself. The basket is colored with shades of silver and light brown that indicate the reflective nature of the metal, and it has a raised, oval base that is also accented with a beaded edge. In the lower left corner, there is an ornate black ink drawing of two stylized fruits, possibly pears, which are surrounded by detailed leaves and small floral elements. In the upper right corner, there is an oval medallion with the text "ROGERS BRO" written on it, giving the impression of a maker's mark or brand. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color, and the composition places the basket prominently in the center, with the fruits on the lower left and the medallion on the upper right.
title: Silver Plate Bread Basket
